currentRole: Owns deterministic CRUD spec normalization, realistic seed generation, SQL CRUD scaffolding, NGX CRUD kit assembly, CRUD status/proof, and viewer evidence helpers.

Hard to review safely because small changes can affect unrelated fast-path layers.
Public rail evolution is blocked by local complexity rather than domain decisions.
boundaryRule: Keep js/tools_crud.js as a thin orchestration facade only.

currentRole: Main Rhino helper layer for DatabaseObject resolution, property handling, NGX creation logic, Studio refresh helpers, and save/runtime invalidation.
problems: Mixes core object operations with NGX-specific creation and project save/version logic.

boundaryRule: Keep js/databaseobject.js as a compatibility facade that assembles focused helpers.

currentRole: Batch mutation execution, partial failure handling, deferred save/refresh/mobile-builder finalization.

currentRole: Central registry for tool schema overrides.

currentRole: Loads prompt catalog and prompt files.
